# The Story Polisher

> A comprehensive writing resource focused on grammar, prose editing, and fiction writing craft, led by editor Christopher Baxter.

The Story Polisher is a blog dedicated to helping writers improve their craft through detailed guides on grammar, sentence structure, narrative technique, and prose quality. The site covers foundational writing skills alongside advanced topics like tense usage, perspective, and stylistic choices.

## Key Topics

- Fiction writing
- Grammar fundamentals
- Prose editing
- Narrative tense
- Sentence structure
- Writing craft
- Editing tips
- Word choice
- Parallel structure
- Pronoun usage
- Adverb usage
- Sentence fragments
- Narrative perspective
- Purple prose
- Writing advice

## Core Pages

- [The Story Polisher](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com): Homepage for The Story Polisher blog with writing tips and prose editing
- [The Purpose of the Polisher](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com/p/the-purpose-of-polisher.html): Explains the purpose and mission of The Story Polisher service
- [About Me](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com/p/about-me.html): About Christopher Baxter, editor and creator of The Story Polisher

## Grammar & Sentence Structure

- [Grammar Basics: What Every Writer Should Know](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/05/grammar-basics-what-every-writer-should.html): Foundational grammar guide covering sentence structure and parts of speech
- [Identifying Sentence Fragments](http://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/03/identifying-sentence-fragments.html): Guide to recognizing and correcting sentence fragments in writing
- [Pronoun Confusion, Part One](http://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/02/lets-talk-about-pronouns-specifically.html): Guide to pronoun usage and avoiding pronoun-antecedent confusion
- [Mismatched Lists, Part One](http://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/05/mismatched-lists-part-one.html): Guide to parallel structure and list formatting with punctuation rules
- [Mismatched Lists, Part Two](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/05/mismatched-lists-part-two.html): Tutorial on parallel structure and proper list formatting in writing

## Narrative Tense & Perspective

- [Perspective and Tense Overview](http://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2014/07/perspective-and-tense-overview.html): Comprehensive guide to narrative perspective and tense combinations
- [Tense Overview: Past vs. Present](http://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/03/tense-overview-past-vs-present.html): Overview comparing past and present tense in fiction writing
- [Tense Errors: Switching Between Past and Present](http://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/03/tense-errors-switching-between-past-and.html): Guide to identifying and fixing tense errors in narrative writing
- [Tricky, Timey-Wimey Tenses](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/06/tricky-timey-wimey-tenses.html): Tutorial on English grammar tenses and verb aspect usage
- [Timey-Wimey Tenses: Past-Tenseception](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/06/timey-wimey-tenses-past-tenseception.html): Guide to using past tense and backstory narrative techniques
- [Timey-Wimey Tenses: Getting Future Tense Right](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2015/06/timey-wimey-tenses-getting-future-tense.html): Guide to using future tense and relative tense in fiction writing

## Prose Style & Word Choice

- [Purple Prose vs. Window Prose](https://storypolisher.blogspot.com/p/window-prose-vs-purple-prose.html): Guide comparing purple prose and window prose with author examples
- [Cleverly Avoiding Adverbs](http://storypolisher.blogspot.com/2014/10/cleverly-avoiding-adverbs.html): Writing advice on reducing adverb usage and improving prose clarity
